reviewed_by: Claude review of harness provider subagents
reason: Harness chats (Codex, Grok) can delegate to one provider model as a subagent. ChatCompletionRequest gains subagent_provider_id/subagent_model; HarnessRuntimeService.prepare_chat validates them through SubagentService.validate_harness_setting (enabled provider, allowlisted and tool-verified model, local-only projects refuse cloud, a cloud provider must permit sensitive data), stores the choice on the chat and harness session, and snapshots it on the turn. The gateway catalog offers subagent.start/wait/list/stop while the setting is on, the developer instructions name the model, and a change reopens the vendor connection (subagent_binding_changed). _gateway_subagent records each call as a ToolCall and drives the existing SubagentService: start creates a ChatSubagent (new fields parent_backend, provider_profile_id, model, reported_at) on the chosen model with the session's MCP servers, the command runtime only when both sides have it, and no SSH hosts; wait is bounded per harness kind (300/600 s Codex, 60/120 s Grok) and wakes on settles; the harness turn's end stops children of a stopped turn and posts finished reports; unreported reports are prepended to the next harness prompt once. Provider-chat subagents keep their behaviour apart from views now naming the model. test_harness_provider_subagents.py drives a scripted harness connection through start/wait/list, late reports reaching the next turn once, a bounded wait, stopping, the catalog/reconnect/instructions following the setting, validation and privacy refusals, delegated-work item kinds, and per-kind wait limits. test_chat_subagents.py guards the provider-parent path; test_harnesses.py and test_harness_adapters.py cover the gateway, connection and instructions code in harnesses.py; test_chat.py, test_chat_queue.py and test_chat_api.py cover the request model, queue dispatch and API wiring. Frontend: HarnessSubagentSettings.test.tsx covers the new Assistant settings section, ChatSubagentPane.test.tsx the harness pane copy and result-card model, client.test.ts the request/session wire mapping. Playwright: the chat-subagents area now also runs the new harness delegation journey on desktop and both phones, and entry:assistant covers SessionsPage (settings popover, request body, rail/pane gating).
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No native tests: no Rust changed. The provider-reasoning area is selected because the SessionsPage request builder next to reasoning effort changed. Other areas that SessionsPage/chat.py/harnesses.py map to (chat-edit-in-place, provider-thinking, conversation-details) run inside the assistant grep, which was run locally on desktop, mobile-chromium and mobile-webkit and passes. activity-ledger is not selected: harnessActivity/ActivityLedger did not change; the backend only relabels subagent.* gateway calls as the existing subagent kind, covered by test_harness_provider_subagents.py. core-api is not selected: the new ChatSubagent and request fields are optional with defaults and the REST paths are covered by test_chat_api.py. test_chat_schedules.py was run locally and passes. ui/src/App.test.tsx 'keeps diagnostics out of the advanced view' fails identically on pristine origin/main and is unrelated.
